correctness.rationale: For the declared n>=2, a>0 and 0<alpha<=1, the symmetric generator has a simple zero eigenvector v and negative complement. Its exact contact speed q_n and dissipative quadratic h_n follow from trigonometric sums. Analytic singular-eigenvalue perturbation yields the q_n times strictly positive Mittag--Leffler subordination variance coefficient, an energy integral and quadratic minimization yield the classical cubic h_n/12 coefficient, and uniform alpha-analytic perturbation proves the joint crossover. Positive subordination and strict semigroup dissipation give global contractivity. Standalone check.py passed 465 finite floating-point diagnostics; these are not substitutes for analytic quantifiers.

value.rationale: At the natural dissipativity threshold, arbitrarily small fractional time mixing causes a structurally sharp change from cubic to fractional quadratic norm contact. The exact dimension-dependent variance and dissipative-matrix coefficients, plus the uniform double limit, identify when the stochastic-time correction overtakes classical hypocoercive smoothing. This naturally bridges fractional Cauchy semigroups and quantitatively sharp hypocoercivity, with an all-dimension theorem rather than an ad-hoc finite computation.
